'''2023 Beezer Bowl''' (also billed as the ''First Annual Beezer Bowl'') was a two-day SWCCG tournament weekend held on 29–30 December 2023 at Avery's Music, on the property of host [[Brian Avery]], in East Hampton, Connecticut. It was organized by the "Connecticut Contingent". The entry fee was one ''Corporal Beezer'' card, or a home-made Beezer creation.<ref name="an">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83879 East Hampton, Connecticut: First Annual Beezer Bowl], Players Committee forum (frodolight, 24 November 2023). Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t83879.html swccg.com snapshot]</ref><ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/inaugural-beezer-bowl-a-major-success/ Inaugural Beezer Bowl a Major Success], starwarsccg.org (9 January 2024). Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/inaugural-beezer-bowl-a-major-success.html swccg.com snapshot]</ref> [[Will Tarbox]] won the Retro event and [[Matt Wadden]] won the Open main event.<ref name="pc" />

== Format ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Date !! Event !! Format
|-
| 29 December 2023 || Retro event (in person and on [[GEMP]]) || Premiere to Death Star II; six games, with the in-person and GEMP winners meeting in a single-game Final Confrontation<ref name="an" /><ref name="ge">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83968 Beezer Bowl: Gemp Parallel Event (RETRO) 29Dec23], Players Committee forum (LargePorg, 27 December 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012151747/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t83968.html Internet Archive]</ref>
|-
| 30 December 2023 || Open main event || [[Open]]; six one-hour games, strength of schedule as tiebreaker<ref name="an" />
|}

[[Thomas Santosuosso|Tommy Santosuosso]] (forum handle LargePorg) ran the GEMP parallel Retro event: he proposed it, posted its rules and prizes, and took the sign-ups.<ref name="ge" />

Thirty players signed up: twenty for the Retro event (eight in person and twelve on GEMP) and ten for the Open event.<ref name="pc" /> Prizes included original paintings by Kate Avery and Tom Brayton (Greebone). Tom Brayton's painting of Admiral Ackbar was the Open grand prize.<ref name="an" /><ref name="pc" /> [[Edward Chien]] was tournament director.<ref name="tr">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1419629#p1419629 La Polka Live - How I Learned to Stop Worrying and Love the Beezers], Players Committee forum (Pistone84, 21 January 2024). Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84078.html swccg.com snapshot]</ref> The event was live-streamed, and it included the first SWCCG halftime show.<ref name="pc" />

=== GEMP Retro sign-ups ===
Players who signed up in the GEMP parallel event thread included [[Matthew Tennyson]], Misha Fitzwater, [[Will Tarbox]], [[Geoff Bowman]], Charlie Hickey, [[Garrett Larson]], [[Clayton Moore]], Alex Prodoehl, Andy Menking and Jeremy Christoffel.<ref name="ge" />
